decisionBox.changed: The direction flipped and the positioning flipped with it. Morning was bearish at 6.0 confidence: price below all four 15m EMAs and all four 1H EMAs, the 1H MACD histogram at -37.23, and a realized-liquidation tape running 44-to-1 in favour of LONG liquidations with 512 forced sells worth 3,402,208 USD. Every one of those has turned. Price is back above the 15m EMA20, EMA50 and EMA100 and above the 1H EMA20; the 1H MACD histogram is +44.58; and the six-hour liquidation window has inverted to 306 SHORT liquidations worth 1,516,516 USD against 98 long liquidations worth 775,300 USD. Underneath it the crowding has cleared rather than deepened: the OKX long/short account ratio has fallen from 1.37 to 1.31 and funding has halved from 0.0001000000000000 to 0.0000525443735586. The stance moves from HOLD-the-core-and-hedge to ADD-to-the-core-without-leverage. The 60 USDT hedge morning opened at 76,795.3 was stopped at 77,185.0 during that squeeze; it is not being re-opened in the other direction on a reclaim that has not settled.

liquidation.note: 663,206 USD across 77 filled orders inside the 76,625-76,875 bucket, 60 sells and 17 buys - the largest single cluster in the six-hour window and the only one with genuine two-way flow. It sits 600.1 points BELOW spot and it is where the morning decline stopped and the reversal started. Two-way liquidation at one price is what a contested level looks like; this is the floor the bullish tilt is standing on.

622,297 USD across 155 fills inside the 77,125-77,375 bucket, of which 153 were BUYS - short liquidations, forced buy-ins. This is the fuel that carried price through the 1H EMA20 at 77,232.17, and spot at 77,350.1 is sitting just 100.1 points above the bucket centre. Because the fills here were forced buys, the shorts that would have to cover into a further rally have already been cleared out of this shelf.

542,488 USD across 60 fills inside the 77,375-77,625 bucket, every single one a BUY. This is the highest short-liquidation shelf of the window and it brackets the session high of 77,579.3, the 1H EMA50 at 77,619.90 and the 15m EMA200 at 77,640.12. It is 149.9 points above spot and it is the reason the add gate is placed at 77,480.0 rather than inside it.

463,825 USD across 112 fills inside the 76,875-77,125 bucket, 36 sells and 76 buys - the level changed hands in both directions as the tape turned. It is 350.1 points below spot and its lower edge is what the reduce gate at 76,850.0 is set beneath.

calibration.rollingRecord: MORNING GRADED: THE GATES WERE RIGHT AND THE DISCRETIONARY TRADE WAS WRONG - FOR THE SECOND SESSION RUNNING, AND IN THE OPPOSITE DIRECTION. Morning set the reduce gate at 76,200.0 requiring a settled 1H close, with price at 76,795.3. The session low since was 76,590.1, so price never came within 390.1 points of the level and the gate is correctly UNFIRED. The add gate at 77,450.0 was also correctly unfired: the session high of 77,579.3 traded 129.3 points THROUGH it, but the highest settled hourly close is 77,290.0, still 160.0 points short. The invalidation at 75,261.8 was never approached and the 76,150.0 stop was never touched. Every rule-based level morning wrote survived the session. What lost money, again, was the discretionary futures position. Morning opened a 60 USDT 2x short at 76,795.3 with the stop at 77,185.0 - deliberately 389.7 points, 0.84 ATR, away, explicitly widened in response to midnight's too-tight tolerance. Price squeezed to 77,579.3 and took it out for roughly -0.30 USDT. So the widened buffer did not save the trade; the trade was simply on the wrong side. The honest reading is that two consecutive sessions have now traded the short side of a pullback inside an intact daily uptrend and both have paid for it, while the untouched spot core has ridden through unharmed. The lesson being carried forward is about direction and instrument, not tolerance: on a timeframe where the daily MACD histogram is positive and price is 2,980.9 points above the daily EMA20, leverage against the primary trend has now cost the book twice, and this session responds by expressing its view in spot only.
calibration.note: priorReduceFired is False and unambiguously so - price never traded near 76,200.0 on either a touch or a settled-close definition, which is the first session in four where the two definitions agree. actingHelped is False: morning's one discretionary act, the 60 USDT short at 76,795.3, was stopped at 77,185.0 for a realized loss, and a desk that had done nothing would be flat and unharmed.
